checks: Multiple tables share tabs; reopening deduplicates; sort/filter/scroll survive switching

Native-style window close returns tabs to the workspace
GIS tables join the detached group and retain search/sort with linked reference selection

Removed GIS layers close their tab and retain the neighboring table
Restoring a scene in the same workspace keeps the other table tabs
Closing the last detached tab closes its utility window and clears the table surface
Per-tab demand-loaded columns and both scroll axes survive switching, detaching and docking
